segments.name: NexGel
segments.description: Manufactures ultra-gentle, high-water-content hydrogel products for healthcare and consumer applications, including branded consumer products and contract manufacturing.
segments.evidence: The NexGel segment is comprised of the manufacturing of ultra-gentle, high-water-content hydrogel products for healthcare and consumer applications, which is based in Langhorne, Pennsylvania as well as the Kenkoderm acquisition, the Silly George acquisition and the Enigma JV.

segments.name: CGN
segments.description: Provides converting and packaging services for finished goods through the CGN joint venture based in Granbury, Texas.
segments.evidence: The CGN segment is comprised of the CGN JV used for the Company's converting and packaging business, which is based in Granbury, Texas.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay NexGel for hydrogel products supplied as a contract manufacturer, branded consumer products sold direct to consumers, and converting and packaging services.
revenueModel.evidence: We distribute our products as a contract manufacturer, supplying our gels to third parties who incorporate them into their own products.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company acquired the Silly George beauty brand.
changes.evidence: On May 15, 2024, the Company entered into and closed a transaction related to an Asset Purchase Agreement dated May 15, 2024

changes.text: In 2024, the Enigma JV included in the NexGel segment was dissolved.
changes.evidence: However, the Enigma JV was dissolved on December 23, 2024.
